compare_ref_guide_young: Read what each part does. What is alike? What is different? Try the question, then explain your thinking.
compare_ref_guide: Compare each function and system membership. Use those details to explain one similarity and one difference, then try the practice question.
compare_ref_progress: A recorded pair tracks exploration. It does not mean you have mastered either structure.
compare_ref_same: These entries describe the same anatomical structure in different browsing collections. Compare their roles; an either-or identification question would be misleading.
compare_ref_system_note: A structure can contribute to more than one body system. Browsing collections are navigation groups.
compare_ref_view_note: Front and back describe where this diagram places a marker. They do not describe the full extent of a structure inside the body.
compare_ref_practice: Practice with the comparison above. Your answer adds one practice attempt; reading or recording a pair adds none.
compare_ref_explain: Explain your choice using a detail from each structure. You can say it aloud or use the “In your own words” notes above.
compare_ref_ready: Your comparison is ready below the selected structure.
compare_ref_choose: Target pinned. Choose a different structure to compare.
compare_ref_pin_hint: Pin this structure, then choose another
